# Vendored third-party code

## qrcode_generator.cjs
`qrcode-generator` 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licensed (licence text is in the file header, unmodified).
Copied verbatim from the npm package so the QR matrix comes from a widely used, independently maintained
encoder rather than code written here. Wrapped by `../qr.js`, which only reads the module matrix.
